## Summary

One-sentence description of the feature you want.

## Problem / Motivation

What problem does this solve? Why is the current behaviour insufficient?

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you'd like the feature to work. Include examples of the
expected API / tool call / output if relevant.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider and why did you reject them?

## Additional Context

Links, references, related issues, or mockups.
